execution: validated REPAIR outputs are mapped mechanically to the frozen Gamma REPLACE_PROPERTY_VALUE input contract

target_contract_gate: RFC-213 exact Gold literals are synthetic canonical strings; the offline target-contract audit must pass before this benchmark can support a confirmatory Direct-IR exact-match claim.
